name: One-Based Arithmetic
description: Prof. Vasechkin wants to represent positive integer n as a sum of addends, where each addends is an integer number containing only 1 s. For example, he can represent 121 as 121=111+11+–1. Help him to find the least number of digits 1 in such sum.
input_specification: The first line of the input contains integer n ( 1 ≤ n < 10 15 ).
output_specification: Print expected minimal number of digits 1 .
approach_summary: Apply Divide and Conquer paradigm under the Basics framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
